attorneys: Mr. Meyer Abrams for petitioners., Messrs. Samuel E. Hirsch, William M. Klein, Lewis C. Jesseph, and Ralph R. Hauxhurst for respondents.

opinions.text: On consideration of the suggestion of a diminution of the record and motion for a writ of certiorari in that relation, the motion for a writ of cer-tiorari is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.
